text: Projects in the local capture tool: create, switch, load
description: Each project has its own folder (captures/<project>/: raw photos, paintings, calibration, settings incl. gallery URL + upload key). Start screen: create/open project. Current test photos become a "test" project; the real digitalization of the attic paintings starts as a fresh project; later client collections get their own projects (possibly their own gallery deployments).

status.comment: captures/projects/<name>/ with per-project raw, paintings, calibration, settings; old captures migrated to 'test'; create/switch verified headless.
